TemplateParameter.description:
One declared template parameter. A parameter with a ``default`` is
optional; one without must appear in every ``parameter_sets`` entry
(``default: null`` counts as no default).
TemplateParameter.title: TemplateParameter

description:
config/<domain>/templates/<name>.yml — one parameterized table spec.

``spec:`` is the body of an ordinary table artifact carrying
``${param.<name>}`` placeholders. A placeholder that IS the whole string
substitutes the typed parameter value (lists/numbers/booleans survive);
inside a longer string only scalar parameters interpolate. Every expanded
spec validates exactly like a hand-written table file.
